about.heading: Who we are
about.text:
Zazzi is a street style magazine about streetwear, trends, self-expression and city vibes. We spot great outfits on the street, share them every day on Instagram under [#ZazziSpotting](https://www.instagram.com/zazzimag/), and write longer stories about the people and ideas behind them.

Spotted a look we should cover, want to be photographed, or have an idea for a story? Get in touch.
